usage: Used for a person whose job is to sell goods or services, especially in shops and department stores.
Common in formal or neutral speech; for very casual everyday talk, people also say 店員 or sales staff depending on the place.
Often comes after a job title or workplace context, and it can refer to one specific worker or the role in general.
A helpful word for beginners because it is clear and direct; use it when talking about jobs, shopping, or customer service.
